parties.name: Labour
parties.summary: Labour commits to supporting the aspiration of every person who meets the requirements and wants to go to university, and pledges to act to create a secure future for higher education, while working with universities to deliver for students and the economy, though no specific tuition fee rate is mentioned.

citations.quote: Labour will continue to support the aspiration of every person who meets the requirements and wants to go to university.

The current higher education funding settlement does not work for the taxpayer, universities, staff, or students. Labour will act to create a secure future for higher education and the opportunities it creates across the UK.

results.headline: Labour pledges 6,500 new expert teachers in key subjects
results.quote: Labour will recruit an additional 6,500 new expert teachers.

results.headline: Labour MP challenges Conservatives on tuition fee legacy
results.quote: Given that plan 2 tuition fees were introduced by the Conservatives in 2012, that they froze the repayment thresholds in 2016 and that they abolished the maintenance grants, was that fair then?

parties.name: Conservative
parties.summary: The Conservatives propose to close university courses with poor outcomes — high drop-out rates or graduates worse off than non-graduates — and commit to ensuring students are not repaid more than they borrowed in real terms, while funding 100,000 apprenticeships partly by curbing poor-quality degrees, but do not propose changes to the headline tuition fee rate.

citations.quote: We will fund this by changing the law to close university courses in England with the worst outcomes for their students. Courses that have excessive drop-out rates or leave students worse off than had they not gone to university will be prevented from recruiting students by the universities regulator.
citations.source: Conservative and Unionist Party Manifesto 2024, p.28

citations.quote: we have already reformed student loans to make them fairer, meaning no one will pay back more than what they borrowed in real terms.
citations.source: Conservative and Unionist Party Manifesto 2024, p.28

results.headline: Conservatives claim children are best readers in the West
results.quote: We recruited record numbers of teachers to help our children become the best readers in the West.

results.headline: Conservative MP: Labour first introduced tuition fees
results.quote: I must be suffering from some sort of political amnesia, because I was absolutely convinced that it was a Labour Government that introduced tuition fees in the first place. Maybe the Minister will correct me.

results.headline: Conservative MP: Labour has now admitted student loans system is broken
results.quote: In January, the Chancellor was saying that the student loans system was 'fair and reasonable'. She now admits 'as of yesterday' that it is broken. In one sense, we have won this debate even before it started.

parties.name: Liberal Democrats
parties.summary: The Liberal Democrats propose to reinstate maintenance grants for disadvantaged students immediately and establish a review of higher education finance to consider reforms to the existing financing system, with an explicit commitment against any further retrospective raising of rates or selling off of loans to private companies.

citations.quote: Reinstate maintenance grants for disadvantaged students immediately to make sure that living costs are not a barrier to studying at university.

Establishing a review of higher education finance in the next Parliament to consider any necessary reforms in the light of the latest evidence of the impact of the existing financing system on access, participation and quality, and make sure there are no more retrospective raising of rates or selling-off of loans to private companies.

results.headline: Lib Dems pledge dedicated mental health professional in every school
results.quote: Putting a dedicated, qualified mental health professional in every school.

parties.name: SNP
parties.summary: The SNP commits to defending free university tuition in Scotland, arguing that graduates in Scotland are thousands of pounds better off as a result, and positions itself as the only party that will protect students and defend free education.

citations.quote: The SNP is the only party that will protect students and defend free education, meaning better off.
Defend free university tuition in Scotland.

results.headline: SNP pledges to defend free university tuition in Scotland
results.quote: Defend free university tuition in Scotland. The SNP is the only party that will protect students and defend free education.

results.headline: SNP MP: Scotland's students pay no tuition fees
results.quote: most income tax payers in Scotland pay less tax. Over and above that, her constituents do not have to pay for their tuition fees.
